periods.name: This Afternoon
periods.detail: Rain and patchy fog and a slight chance of thunderstorms. Some of the storms could produce heavy rain. Cloudy, with a high near 68. South wind around 8 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between a half and three quarters of an inch possible.

Some of the storms could produce heavy rain. Cloudy, with a low around 56. Southwest wind 2 to 6 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between 1 and 2 inches possible.

New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.
